# CapCar — Digital Garage

> Optional navigation draft. Not deployed. No ranking or AI citation benefit is claimed.

CapCar helps owners plan upgrades, track costs and keep maintenance records with
their car. Explore public tools; an account saves personal vehicles and plans.

## Public pages
- [CapCar](https://capcar.dev/): Product overview and illustrative garage example.
- [How it works](https://capcar.dev/platform): Current product workflows and scope.
- [Project car planner](https://capcar.dev/project-car-planner): Parts, budget and progress planning.
- [Maintenance tracker](https://capcar.dev/car-maintenance-tracker): Owner-recorded service history.
- [Journal](https://capcar.dev/en/journal): Practical preparation and documentation articles.
- [AI trip planner](https://capcar.dev/ai): Public example; own plans require an account and connected service.

Examples are illustrative unless explicitly documented as real. Vehicle records
are not independent workshop certification. Confirm part fitment, safety and
applicable instructions separately. Retailer checkout and provider charges may
apply outside CapCar's core beta garage.
